g.title: BDEF0
g.text: b(x) = κ(x) γ(x) − λ μ(x), λ > 0 contradiction cost
CD choice for the coefficient b of V1′

g.title: PDE
g.text: −ΔΦ = a(x)|∇Φ| + b(x)Φ − c(x)Φᵖ in M, Φ = 0 on ∂M

g.title: RESULTS
g.text: Existence (Theorem 3.12): a nonnegative weak coherent configuration exists;
Positive existence (Theorem 3.16): λ₁ < 0 ⇒ a solution positive in the interior
Exact threshold (Proposition 3.19): λ₁ < 0 is also necessary when a ≡ 0
With drive (Proposition 3.21): not necessary in general when a ≢ 0;
counterexample: a positive solution with λ₁ = +1/4 on an interval

g.title: OP:e->BDEF
g.text: b(·, t) re-evaluated at each t

g.title: EROSION
g.text: κ̇ = −δ_κ [D − D_crit]⁺, γ̇ = −δ_γ [D − D_crit]⁺, μ̇ = +δ_μ [D − D_crit]⁺
with κ, γ, μ projected onto [0,1]
or erosion through the effective manifold M(t)

g.title: PSIS
g.text: proposed proxy; comparing it with ψ

g.title: FGRAPH
g.text: and the edge condition a(x), a(y) ≤ √w(x,y)
for all distinct interior vertices x, y with w(x,y) > 0
⇒ a solution with u(x) > 0 at every interior vertex x

g.title: PSI
g.text: ψ(t) ∈ [0,1], ψ ∈ C³ or declared estimators

g.title: RBASE
g.text: α₁, α₃ > 0, β ≥ 0; α₁, β, α₃ in units of time, time², time³

g.title: LAMEFF
g.text: λ_eff = λ₀ / R, λ₀ > 0 baseline cost

g.title: LOOP
g.text: ψ > ψₛ sustained ⇒ D ↑ ⇒ R ↓ ⇒ λ_eff ↑ ⇒ b ↓ ⇒ λ₁ ↑ ⇒ ψₛ ↓
D rises only while D < (η/ρ) [ψ − ψₛ]⁺ (Remark 3.39)
a fragility tendency; convergence, oscillation or saturation is not analysed

g.title: INTERP
g.text: smooth, stabilizing ψ (large R_base) lowers λ_eff
changes of M(t) or of the fields shift ψₛ through λ₁(t)
no prediction theorem; the falsifiability tests are separate proposals (Section 5.2)
